Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the call today — great to hear more about FinPath's roadmap for automating customer support summaries. Quick recap and proposed next steps:

- Need: low-latency assistant for summarizing multi-turn conversations and extracting key follow-up items.
- Primary constraints: PII handling for banking data, regionally compliant deployment options, and predictable token costs for high traffic.
- Next milestone: technical demo + deep-dive with platform/security/procurement to align on architecture and controls.

Would any of these slots work for a 45-minute technical demo next week?
- Tue 3/23 10:30–11:15 PT
- Wed 3/24 13:00–13:45 PT
- Thu 3/25 09:00–09:45 PT

I'm looping in our security and procurement leads as optional in the thread so we can lock a time that works for everyone. Attached: redwood-product-one-pager.pdf (quick product summary).

If those times don't work, happy to propose a few more.

Best,
Marissa Cole
